title_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Chain of Transmission and Implications - Episode 37
description_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Chain of Transmission and Implications - Episode 37, an episode of the Mahdawi Thesis program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari is part of the Mahdawi Thesis program broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV, focusing on the chains of transmission and implications of Hadith al-Thaqalayn.
